mt: 'IRISH LEFT ARCHIVE' ON THE OVERVIEW — THE ARCHIVE AT ITS GRAIN, ITS TIMELINE OF ORGANISATIONS GIVEN; ITS ORIGIN IN THE CEDAR LOUNGE REVOLUTION NOT CARRIED
d: THE ARCHIVE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Irish Left Archive is a digital project and online repository dedicated to collecting, preserving, and sharing material related to left-wing politics, activism, and history in Ireland.' Digital collection; timeline; scope; personal accounts; the podcast. Four cards: the archive, Spotify, Pocket Casts, mastodon.online.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the archive, the Overview gives its holdings, its timeline of organisations, its personal accounts and its podcast.
findings: THE HOLDINGS AT THEIR GRAIN. 'An interactive timeline tracking Irish left organizations and parties from 1900 to the present.' The archive keeps every organisation of a fissile left, its rival parties included, on one record and one timeline.
THE ORIGIN NOT CARRIED. 'It was initiated by the Cedar Lounge Revolution .' (the archive's home page). The composition names the podcast's hosts and no holder of the archive.
analysis: Faithful at the level of holdings and features. The archive's founding by a left blog's community, which is who holds the record, is absent.
per_note: The archive and its podcast cited; no holder named.
